-> int (モデル内のメッシュ数。深さ優先の出現順)
ja.description:
同じモデルを何百個も並べたいとき、GLB を個数ぶん読んで Mesh を並べると
draw call がそのまま個数になる。getPartGeometry / getPartMaterial で取り出して
InstancedMesh へまとめると 1 個で済む。

tr.summary: -> int (number of meshes in the model, in depth-first order of appearance)
tr.description:
To place hundreds of copies of the same model, loading the GLB once per copy and placing Meshes
results in one draw call per copy. Extracting the parts with getPartGeometry / getPartMaterial and
combining them into an InstancedMesh needs only one.
